The flag is at /tmp/dojo-rootfs/secret/flag.txt — but reading it directly from the host is cheating. You need to enter the rootfs so it appears as / to your process

sudo unshare --fork --pid --mount /bin/bash creates new PID and mount namespaces. Inside, mount --bind /tmp/dojo-rootfs /tmp/dojo-rootfs then pivot_root /tmp/dojo-rootfs /tmp/dojo-rootfs/old-root makes it your /
The easiest valid method: sudo chroot /tmp/dojo-rootfs /bin/sh — this changes / to the rootfs and you can read /secret/flag.txt directly
